changeinfo.changes:
WARNING:
All of the PlayStation®4, PlayStation®3, PlayStation®TV and PlayStation®Vita systems in a LAN game must have this patch applied in order to join the game. Daily Challenges recorded with an outdated version won't play.
Features added: New Fast Forward function for replays
Bugs fixed: Saved games could become corrupted under some circumstances Fixed invisible sprites for the black character Some textures were being rendered incorrectly when using the quick start feature Desynchronization issues in LAN games Many other minor fixes and optimizations
